verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה הָאָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת מֵסִ֤יר מִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּמִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה מַשְׁעֵ֖ן וּמַשְׁעֵנָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל מִשְׁעַן־ לֶ֔חֶם וְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁעַן־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh hā·’ā·ḏō·wn Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ mê·sîr mî·rū·šā·lim ū·mî·hū·ḏāh maš·‘ên ū·maš·‘ê·nāh kōl miš·‘an- le·ḥem wə·ḵōl miš·‘an- mā·yim
verses.literal: For behold the Lord GOD of Hosts is about to remove from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support the whole supply of food . . . . . . and water

verses.original: גִּבּ֖וֹר וְאִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה שׁוֹפֵ֥ט וְנָבִ֖יא וְקֹסֵ֥ם וְזָקֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: gib·bō·wr wə·’îš mil·ḥā·māh šō·w·p̄êṭ wə·nā·ḇî wə·qō·sêm wə·zā·qên
verses.literal: the mighty man and the warrior . . . the judge and the prophet the soothsayer and the elder

verses.original: שַׂר־ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וּנְשׂ֣וּא פָנִ֑ים וְיוֹעֵ֛ץ וַחֲכַ֥ם חֲרָשִׁ֖ים וּנְב֥וֹן לָֽחַשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: śar- ḥă·miš·šîm ū·nə·śū p̄ā·nîm wə·yō·w·‘êṣ wa·ḥă·ḵam ḥă·rā·šîm ū·nə·ḇō·wn lā·ḥaš
verses.literal: the commander of fifty and the dignitary . . . the counselor the cunning magician and the clever enchanter

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י נְעָרִ֖ים שָׂרֵיהֶ֑ם וְתַעֲלוּלִ֖ים יִמְשְׁלוּ־ בָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî nə·‘ā·rîm śā·rê·hem wə·ṯa·‘ă·lū·lîm yim·šə·lū- ḇām
verses.literal: I will make mere lads their leaders and children will rule over them

verses.original: הָעָ֔ם וְנִגַּ֣שׂ אִ֥ישׁ בְּאִ֖ישׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ הַנַּ֙עַר֙ יִרְהֲב֗וּ בַּזָּקֵ֔ן וְהַנִּקְלֶ֖ה בַּנִּכְבָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām wə·nig·gaś ’îš bə·’îš wə·’îš bə·rê·‘ê·hū han·na·‘ar yir·hă·ḇū baz·zā·qên wə·han·niq·leh ban·niḵ·bāḏ
verses.literal: The people will oppress one another man against man neighbor against neighbor the young will rise up against the old and the base against the honorable

verses.original: אִ֤ישׁ כִּֽי־ יִתְפֹּ֨שׂ בְּאָחִיו֙ אָבִ֔יו בֵּ֣ית שִׂמְלָ֣ה לְכָ֔ה תִּֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑נוּ קָצִ֖ין תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽךָ׃ הַזֹּ֖את וְהַמַּכְשֵׁלָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ’îš kî- yiṯ·pōś bə·’ā·ḥîw ’ā·ḇîw bêṯ śim·lāh lə·ḵāh tih·yeh- lā·nū qā·ṣîn ta·ḥaṯ yā·ḏe·ḵā haz·zōṯ wə·ham·maḵ·šê·lāh
verses.literal: A man - will seize his brother within his father’s house You have a cloak . . . you be our leader vvv Take charge of this heap of rubble

verses.original: הַה֤וּא׀ בַיּ֨וֹם יִשָּׂא֩ לֵאמֹר֙ אֶהְיֶ֣ה לֹא־ חֹבֵ֔שׁ אֵ֥ין לֶ֖חֶם וְאֵ֣ין שִׂמְלָ֑ה וּבְבֵיתִ֕י לֹ֥א תְשִׂימֻ֖נִי קְצִ֥ין עָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū ḇay·yō·wm yiś·śā lê·mōr ’eh·yeh lō- ḥō·ḇêš ’ên le·ḥem wə·’ên śim·lāh ū·ḇə·ḇê·ṯî lō ṯə·śî·mu·nî qə·ṣîn ‘ām
verses.literal: On that day he will cry aloud - I am not a healer I have no food . . . or clothing in my house Do not make me leader of the people

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כָשְׁלָה֙ וִיהוּדָ֖ה נָפָ֑ל כִּֽי־ לְשׁוֹנָ֤ם וּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה לַמְר֖וֹת כְבוֹדֽוֹ׃ עֵנֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: kî yə·rū·šā·lim ḵā·šə·lāh wî·hū·ḏāh nā·p̄āl kî- lə·šō·w·nām ū·ma·‘al·lê·hem ’el- Yah·weh lam·rō·wṯ ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏōw ‘ê·nê
verses.literal: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen because they spoke and acted against the LORD defying His glorious presence

verses.original: הַכָּרַ֤ת פְּנֵיהֶם֙ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֔ם כִּסְדֹ֥ם הִגִּ֖ידוּ וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם לֹ֣א כִחֵ֑דוּ א֣וֹי לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם כִּֽי־ גָמְל֥וּ רָעָֽה׃ לָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: hak·kā·raṯ pə·nê·hem ‘ā·nə·ṯāh bām kis·ḏōm hig·gî·ḏū wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯām lō ḵi·ḥê·ḏū ’ō·w lə·nap̄·šām kî- ḡā·mə·lū rā·‘āh lā·hem
verses.literal: The expression on their faces testifies against them and like Sodom they flaunt their sin they do not conceal it Woe to them for they have brought disaster upon themselves

verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ צַדִּ֖יק כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּֽי־ יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃ פְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ’im·rū ṣad·dîq kî- ṭō·wḇ kî- yō·ḵê·lū p̄ə·rî ma·‘al·lê·hem
verses.literal: Tell the righteous - it will be well with them for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor

verses.original: א֖וֹי לְרָשָׁ֣ע רָ֑ע כִּֽי־ גְמ֥וּל יָדָ֖יו יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lə·rā·šā‘ rā‘ kî- ḡə·mūl yā·ḏāw yê·‘ā·śeh lōw
verses.literal: Woe to the wicked disaster [is upon them] For they will be repaid with what their hands have done

verses.original: מְעוֹלֵ֔ל נֹגְשָׂ֣יו עַמִּי֙ וְנָשִׁ֖ים מָ֣שְׁלוּ ב֑וֹ עַמִּי֙ מְאַשְּׁרֶ֣יךָ מַתְעִ֔ים בִּלֵּֽעוּ׃ס וְדֶ֥רֶךְ אֹֽרְחֹתֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: mə·‘ō·w·lêl nō·ḡə·śāw ‘am·mî wə·nā·šîm mā·šə·lū ḇōw ‘am·mî mə·’aš·šə·re·ḵā maṯ·‘îm bil·lê·‘ū wə·ḏe·reḵ ’ō·rə·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Youths oppress My people and women rule over them O My people your guides mislead you they turn you . . . from your paths

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה נִצָּ֥ב לָרִ֖יב וְעֹמֵ֖ד לָדִ֥ין עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ lā·rîḇ wə·‘ō·mêḏ lā·ḏîn ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: The LORD arises to contend He stands to judge the people

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ יָב֔וֹא בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט עִם־ זִקְנֵ֥י וְשָׂרָ֑יו עַמּ֖וֹ וְאַתֶּם֙ בִּֽעַרְתֶּ֣ם הַכֶּ֔רֶם גְּזֵלַ֥ת הֶֽעָנִ֖י בְּבָתֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yā·ḇō·w bə·miš·pāṭ ‘im- ziq·nê wə·śā·rāw ‘am·mōw wə·’at·tem bi·‘ar·tem hak·ke·rem gə·zê·laṯ he·‘ā·nî bə·ḇāt·tê·ḵem
verses.literal: The LORD brings this charge against the elders and leaders of His people You have devoured the vineyard the plunder of the poor is in your houses

verses.original: מַלָּכֶם תְּדַכְּא֣וּ עַמִּ֔י תִּטְחָ֑נוּ וּפְנֵ֥י עֲנִיִּ֖ים נְאֻם־ אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: mal·lå̄·ḵɛm tə·ḏak·kə·’ū ‘am·mî tiṭ·ḥā·nū ū·p̄ə·nê ‘ă·nî·yîm nə·’um- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor declares the Lord GOD of Hosts

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֔וֹן גָֽבְהוּ֙ וַתֵּלַ֙כְנָה֙ גָּר֔וֹן נְטוּוֹת וּֽמְשַׂקְּר֖וֹת עֵינָ֑יִם הָל֤וֹךְ וְטָפֹף֙ תֵּלַ֔כְנָה תְּעַכַּֽסְנָה׃ וּבְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ya·‘an kî bə·nō·wṯ ṣî·yō·wn ḡā·ḇə·hū wat·tê·laḵ·nāh gā·rō·wn nə·ṭūōṯ ū·mə·śaq·qə·rō·wṯ ‘ê·nā·yim hā·lō·wḵ wə·ṭā·p̄ōp̄ tê·laḵ·nāh tə·‘ak·kas·nāh ū·ḇə·raḡ·lê·hem
verses.literal: The LORD also says Because . . . the daughters of Zion are haughty walking with heads held high and wanton eyes prancing and skipping as they go jingling the bracelets on their ankles

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֔י וְשִׂפַּ֣ח קָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֑וֹן וַיהוָ֖ה פָּתְהֵ֥ן יְעָרֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·śip·paḥ qā·ḏə·qōḏ bə·nō·wṯ ṣî·yō·wn Yah·weh pā·ṯə·hên yə·‘ā·reh
verses.literal: the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the daughters of Zion and the LORD will make their foreheads bare

verses.original: הַה֜וּא בַּיּ֨וֹם אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵ֣ת יָסִ֣יר תִּפְאֶ֧רֶת הָעֲכָסִ֛ים וְהַשְּׁבִיסִ֖ים וְהַשַּׂהֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’êṯ yā·sîr tip̄·’e·reṯ hā·‘ă·ḵā·sîm wə·haš·šə·ḇî·sîm wə·haś·śa·hă·rō·nîm
verses.literal: In that day the Lord - will take away their finery [their] anklets and headbands and crescents

verses.original: הַנְּטִיפ֥וֹת וְהַשֵּׁיר֖וֹת וְהָֽרְעָלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ṭî·p̄ō·wṯ wə·haš·šê·rō·wṯ wə·hā·rə·‘ā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: [their] pendants bracelets and veils

verses.original: הַפְּאֵרִ֤ים וְהַצְּעָדוֹת֙ וְהַקִּשֻּׁרִ֔ים הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ וּבָתֵּ֥י וְהַלְּחָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: hap·pə·’ê·rîm wə·haṣ·ṣə·‘ā·ḏō·wṯ wə·haq·qiš·šu·rîm han·ne·p̄eš ū·ḇāt·tê wə·hal·lə·ḥā·šîm
verses.literal: [their] headdresses ankle chains and sashes [their] perfume bottles and charms

verses.original: הַטַּבָּע֖וֹת הָאָֽף׃ וְנִזְמֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ō·wṯ hā·’āp̄ wə·niz·mê
verses.literal: [their] signet rings and nose rings

verses.original: הַמַּֽחֲלָצוֹת֙ וְהַמַּ֣עֲטָפ֔וֹת וְהַמִּטְפָּח֖וֹת וְהָחֲרִיטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ham·ma·ḥă·lā·ṣō·wṯ wə·ham·ma·‘ă·ṭā·p̄ō·wṯ wə·ham·miṭ·pā·ḥō·wṯ wə·hā·ḥă·rî·ṭîm
verses.literal: [their] festive robes capes cloaks and purses

verses.original: וְהַגִּלְיֹנִים֙ וְהַסְּדִינִ֔ים וְהַצְּנִיפ֖וֹת וְהָרְדִידִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hag·gil·yō·nîm wə·has·sə·ḏî·nîm wə·haṣ·ṣə·nî·p̄ō·wṯ wə·hā·rə·ḏî·ḏîm
verses.literal: and [their] mirrors linen garments tiaras and shawls

verses.original: תַ֨חַת בֹּ֜שֶׂם וְהָיָה֩ מַ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֗ה וְתַ֨חַת חֲגוֹרָ֤ה נִקְפָּה֙ וְתַ֨חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה מִקְשֶׁה֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְתַ֥חַת פְּתִיגִ֖יל מַחֲגֹ֣רֶת שָׂ֑ק תַ֖חַת יֹֽפִי׃ כִּי־
verses.transliteration: ṯa·ḥaṯ bō·śem wə·hā·yāh maq yih·yeh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ ḥă·ḡō·w·rāh niq·pāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ ma·‘ă·śeh miq·šeh qā·rə·ḥāh wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ pə·ṯî·ḡîl ma·ḥă·ḡō·reṯ śāq ṯa·ḥaṯ yō·p̄î kî-
verses.literal: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench . . . instead of a belt a rope instead of styled hair baldness instead of fine clothing sackcloth . . . instead of beauty shame

verses.original: מְתַ֖יִךְ יִפֹּ֑לוּ בַּחֶ֣רֶב וּגְבוּרָתֵ֖ךְ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ṯa·yiḵ yip·pō·lū ba·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯêḵ bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Your men will fall by the sword and your warriors in battle

verses.original: פְּתָחֶ֑יהָ וְאָנ֥וּ וְאָבְל֖וּ וְנִקָּ֖תָה תֵּשֵֽׁב׃ לָאָ֥רֶץ
verses.transliteration: pə·ṯā·ḥe·hā wə·’ā·nū wə·’ā·ḇə·lū wə·niq·qā·ṯāh tê·šêḇ lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And the gates [of Zion] will lament and mourn destitute she will sit on the ground
